response.justification: The candidate is technically an excellent match on skills — strong TypeScript/Node.js/React experience, AWS and Kubernetes exposure, and recent AI-agent/MCP work covering nearly every nice-to-have. However, with roughly 18 years of experience and current Staff-level seniority, he is dramatically overqualified for an entry-level junior/mid position, raising serious concerns about retention, compensation fit, and motivation for taking this role.
strengths: Deep TypeScript, Node.js, and React experience across multiple product companies
Covers nice-to-haves: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and recent LLM/MCP agent tooling work
Proven fullstack breadth from databases to UI, plus geo-data platform ownership relevant to domain platforms
concerns: Severely overqualified for an entry-level role — flight and salary-mismatch risk
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (MongoDB/MySQL listed instead)
Frequent job changes and side ventures may conflict with high on-site presence and long-term commitment

key_factors.factor: AWS, Kubernetes, and LLM tooling experience
